figurative_meaning_en: unbearable mental agony from intense remorse
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার অতীতের ভুলের জন্য নরকযন্ত্রণা হচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is going through hellish torment due to his past mistake.
She is suffering unbearable mental agony from remorse.
note: The idiom draws from the concept of hell in Bengali religious and cultural narratives.
